# Support-method transfer development fixture

Four original synthetic dossiers extend the known development cases with
competitor assertions, matching measurement windows, regional template mistakes
and supportable editorial claims. Six material gold units are held in `gold/`.
Copy only `targets/` to a model project; do not expose this README or gold.

Source prompts and facts are author-written, not copied upstream examples or real
customer records. Both hosts must receive identical bytes and keep each scenario
separate. Freeze target and gold hashes before native execution. The set has no
critical security case and cannot certify transport boundaries or real extraction.

Assess all report text and the final reply, including corrections, scope, controls,
quotation fidelity, computed denominators, missing measurements and workflow
compliance. Detecting all gold issues alone is not release acceptance. Additional
findings require independent support review rather than automatic false-positive
classification. These are primary-agent labels; human acceptance remains open.

Status: native execution completed; independent acceptance remains pending.

Native execution on candidate 0.1.26 has now completed on both supported hosts. Each found
6/6 seeded issues; neither produced validator-backed coverage. See the research trial
`docs/research/content-search-audit-trials/support-methods-0126/README.md` for preserved
reports, quote replay, semantic limitations and the independent-review boundary.
